About me

It was 2008 when I took an undergraduate course named IT Management for Business at the University of Manchester and I came across with user experience. Since then I fell in love with UX design and therefore I went to the University of Bath to take the HCI course and completed my master degree there,

Now I've committed myself into user experience design for for 10 years and have rich experiences in Business Development, Requirements Analysis, User Research, Data Analysis, IA, Interaction Design, Usability Testing, and Project Management. I have worked closely with clients providing my UX advises and designs for multi-platform products in different industries. I've worked as vendors and designed for different clients and also worked as in-house designer to design our own products. Both experiences have excited me.

I also love various activities including dancing, scuba diving, traveling, reading, watching football, etc.

关于我

2008年，我在曼彻斯特大学攻读了商务信息技术管理的本科课程。在那里我第一次了解到了用户体验。 从那以后我便爱上了用户体验和交互设计，因此我选择去巴斯大学继续攻读人机交互课程，并在那里完成了我的硕士学位，

现在我已经在用户体验设计领域工作10年了，并且在需求分析、用户研究、数据分析、信息架构、交互设计、可用性测试、业务开发和项目管理等方面拥有丰富的经验。我曾与客户密切合作，为不同行业的多平台产品提供用户体验建议和设计。我曾作为供应商工作，为不同的客户设计，也有作为内部设计师设计自己产品的经验。两种经历我都非常享受并受益匪浅。

我也喜欢参加各种活动，包括跳舞、潜水、旅游、阅读、看球赛等。
